title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
supporting_stats: Offensive Rebound: 69.0% on 29 attempts; Cut: 68.5% on 92 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points above their 47.1% overall clip on 15+ attempts. Offensive Rebound: hit a body on every shot before going to the ball. Cut: jump to the ball on every pass and see man and ball -- no back-cuts behind ball-watchers.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
supporting_stats: Off Screen: 32.3% on 31 attempts; P&R Ball Handler: 36.4% on 162 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points below their 47.1% overall clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure the actions they turn it over on
supporting_stats: P&R Ball Handler: 48 TO in 210 uses (22.9% vs 13.8% across all actions); ISO: 12 TO in 59 uses (20.3% vs 13.8% across all actions)
recommendation: Loosest actions per use, not the most common ones -- load ball pressure and gap help onto these specifically rather than pressing everything.
